title: Service Administrator
description: Service Administrator Location: Leatherhead Salary: Competitive (DOE) Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm Overview We are seeking an organised and customer-focused Service Administrator to join a busy service operations team. This role is responsible for coordinating engineers, scheduling maintenance works, managing service requests, and ensuring jobs are completed efficiently from initial booking through to invoicing. The successful candidate will be a strong communicator with experience working in a fast-paced service environment. A key requirement is proven experience coordinating and scheduling engineers and acting as a central point of contact between clients, suppliers, contractors, and field-based technical teams. Key Responsibilities - Coordinate and schedule reactive and planned maintenance work for engineers. - Manage engineer diaries and ensure service levels are maintained. - Monitor planned preventative maintenance (PPM) schedules and ensure works are completed on time. - Act as the first point of contact for incoming calls from customers, suppliers, contractors, and engineers. - Arrange site access for engineers and subcontractors. - Order parts and materials as required. - Process purchase invoices and assist with job completion and invoicing. - Provide regular updates to customers on job progress and completion status. - Produce reports, maintain databases, and support administrative processes. - Verify engineer timesheets and expenses where required. - Maintain accurate records, filing systems, and service documentation. Essential Skills & Experience - Previous experience coordinating, scheduling, or dispatching engineers is essential. - Experience working within a service desk, helpdesk, facilities management, engineering, maintenance, or similar operational environment. - Strong customer service and communication skills. - Comfortable liaising with customers, suppliers, contractors, and mobile engineering teams. - Excellent organisational skills and ability to prioritise a high volume of work. - Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook. - Strong attention to detail and administrative skills. - Professional telephone manner and excellent written and verbal English. title: Customer Service Advisors
description: Looking for a customer service role that can grow into a long-term career? Insure Recruitment is delighted to be supporting an award-winning insurance business that is expanding its Customer Service team with two exciting opportunities for enthusiastic, customer-focused individuals. If you have customer service or telephone-based experience, this is a fantastic opportunity to build a rewarding career in insurance with full training, ongoing support and progression opportunities. What's on offer? - £25,000 salary. - Hybrid working, minimum three days in the office and two days from home (after successfully your three-month probation). - Company laptop and headset provided. - Team bonus scheme- earn up to £450 when monthly team commission targets are exceeded (subject to quality measures after probation). - Perkbox membership with discounts on shopping, restaurants, cinemas and gyms. - Professional development and funded learning opportunities. - Annual leave with the option to buy or sell holiday. - Interest-free season ticket loan. - Life assurance. - Enhanced maternity and paternity benefits. - A supportive, collaborative team environment with clear career progression. The role As an Insurance Customer Service Executive, you'll be the trusted first point of contact for customers, providing outstanding service while helping them find insurance solutions that meet their needs. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include: - Advising customers on insurance cover options and arranging suitable policies. - Providing quotations and processing payments. - Handling customer enquiries professionally and empathetically. - Accurately updating customer information across internal systems. - Supporting customer retention and identifying cross-selling opportunities. - Working in line with FCA guidelines and company quality standards. - Completing structured training and on-the-job learning to develop your insurance knowledge. Who are we looking for? - At least one year of office, customer service or telephone-based experience - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills - A positive, team-oriented approach - Confidence using computer systems and managing customer interactions - A genuine desire to build a career in insurance Insurance experience is an advantage, but it isn't essential. We're looking for people with the right attitude, strong customer service skills and a willingness to learn. After successfully completing your probation, you'll become eligible for the team bonus scheme. For example, if the team achieves 5% above its monthly commission target, you could receive a £450 bonus, subject to meeting quality standards, including no failed calls during the month and achieving your individual cross-selling targets. Start your insurance career today! These are two fantastic opportunities to join a business that genuinely invests in its people through structured training, continuous development and long-term career progression. At Insure Recruitment, we're proud to work with clients who are committed to building diverse, inclusive and authentic workplaces. If this role excites you, but your experience doesn't match every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you- you could be exactly who we're looking for!

title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Job Description: We are seeking an energetic and dedicated Customer Service Advisor to join our clients dynamic team. In this role, you will be the frontline representative responsible for delivering exceptional service to their prestigious customers, ensuring their needs are met with enthusiasm and professionalism. Your proactive approach will help foster positive relationships, resolve inquiries efficiently, and contribute to a seamless customer experience. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and possess strong communication skills, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact while developing your career in customer service. Role and Responsibilities: - Engage with customers via phone and email to address inquiries, provide service information, and resolve issues promptly. - Utilise the inhouse operations system to provide quotes, manage bookings and to support invoice processing. - Provide track and trace information data to clients on request. - Contribute to team goals by participating in training sessions, sharing best practices, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives. - Support and build strong relationships with our clients customer base. Requirements: - A minimum of 1 year experience in a customer service role is preferred from any industry. - Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal. - Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. - Demonstrated problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude towards resolving customer concerns. - IT proficiency in Word, Outlook and Excel. - Polite and professional telephone manner. Employee Benefits: Our client offers a range of benefits designed to support their employees financial wellbeing, health, professional development and work-life balance: - Free Onsite Parking - Workplace Pension Employer contributions to support your long-term financial planning. - Private Medical Insurance Available from January following the start of your employment. - Gym Benefit Access to a gym benefit to support your health and wellbeing. - Electric Vehicle Scheme Access to an electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme. - Cycle to Work Scheme A tax-efficient way to purchase a bicycle and cycling equipment for commuting. - Working from Home Allowance 20 days available to eligible office-based employees. - Training & Professional Development Opportunities for training, professional qualifications and ongoing career development. - Technology & Equipment A company mobile phone and laptop provided where required for your role. This is an excellent role within a friendly, professional and ever growing business.

title: Helpdesk Coordinator
description: Helpdesk Coordinator Up to £34,000 Permanent A fantastic opportunity has arisen for an organised, confident and personable Helpdesk Coordinator to join a leading company based in Tadworth. We're looking for someone who enjoys keeping things running smoothly, providing excellent customer service and coordinating engineers effectively. You'll be a key point of contact for customers and clients while managing the day-to-day administration that keeps the helpdesk operating efficiently. If you're someone who can communicate confidently at all levels, enjoys being part of a busy team and appreciates a bit of office banter along the way, this could be the role for you! The Role As Helpdesk Coordinator, your responsibilities will include: - Coordinating and managing engineers' daily schedules, covering both reactive and preventative maintenance - Acting as the first point of contact for customers and clients, handling telephone calls, emails and general queries - Managing engineers' diaries and allocating jobs efficiently - Completing general administration, including reviewing reports, filing and ordering parts through the internal system - Uploading and allocating documents to online systems, ensuring records are accurate and kept up to date - Preparing paperwork and documentation for site audits - Assisting with expense forms and managing holiday and sickness records - Coordinating vehicle issues and arranging servicing and maintenance bookings - Liaising with engineers, customers and internal teams to ensure jobs are completed efficiently - Providing general support to the wider team as required About You We're looking for someone who is: - Ideally experienced in a helpdesk, scheduling, coordination or similar administrative role - although this isn't essential - Confident, polite and professional, with excellent communication skills - Organised and able to manage multiple tasks and changing priorities - IT literate and comfortable using computer-based systems - Customer-focused with a friendly and approachable manner - A team player with a positive attitude and a good sense of humour - Educated to GCSE level, with grades C or above - A driver with a full driving licence The Opportunity This is a varied Helpdesk Coordinator role within a friendly and busy team, where no two days are the same. If you're organised, enjoy working with people and are looking for a role where you can make a real difference to the smooth running of a busy helpdesk, we'd love to hear from you.
